description: Add a milestone to a trail. Add a named stage to the trail, with an optional description and target date. Milestones are ordered: omit `position` to add it last, or pass one to insert it there and move the rest down. Progress is counted per milestone, and the build works the trail milestone by milestone …

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

position.description: Where to put it in the trail's order, from `0`; the milestones at and after it move down one. Omitted, it goes last.

targetDate.description: The calendar day it is meant to be done by (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or `null`.

name: trails_milestones_add
